name: marketing_routing
description: Checks that a plain-English request reaches the right specialist. Descriptions are the routing logic, so re-run this whenever one changes. expect_agent may be null where only the orchestrator matters.

cases.prompt: How did our campaigns perform last week?
Which channel is giving us the cheapest opportunities?
What should we do to improve marketing performance this quarter?
Where should we move budget to get more pipeline?
How is our pipeline looking?
Are we going to hit our number in EMEA?
Which deals are stuck and not moving?
What assets are moving the needle on moving accounts forward?
Build me the pipeline deck for this week
I need the demand council deck and analysis for the monthly review
Analyse accounts with no opportunity and suggest where we should run events
Which city should our next field event be in, and what topic?
Build me a list of targeted contacts at the Munich accounts for the event
Who should we invite from ACC-001 and ACC-002?
Give me a brief on each account attending the Munich roundtable
I need background one-pagers on the accounts coming to EVT-001
Summarise the pipeline in the room for the Munich event
What is the Singapore breakfast event actually worth to us?
Create a Salesforce campaign for the EMEA Zero Trust webinar in Q4
Build me a segment in 6sense of financial services accounts in EMEA surging on Zero Trust
Deploy that segment to Marketo
Load event_leads_munich.csv into Marketo
I have a list of event leads that needs uploading
Set up a segment of manufacturing accounts over 5000 employees
Give me some campaign ideas for the new product launch
Build me a campaign brief for Q4 demand gen
Build competitive messaging against our main rival
What are my top accounts?
Run intel analysis and gap and value mapping on my named accounts
Write me an anchor asset on Zero Trust
Translate this asset into German
Build me an asset grid for the regional campaign
What is our share of voice looking like this month?
Monitor social sentiment and draft a response to the negative posts
Build me a campaign brief
cases.note: Near neighbour of campaign performance. 'Brief' plus 'build' means design, not analysis.

cases.prompt: Generate a PPT for the upcoming selected campaign
cases.note: A campaign PowerPoint is design, not the pipeline review deck.

cases.prompt: Build me a campaign performance analysis
cases.note: The mirror of amb-01. Same verb, opposite destination.

cases.prompt: Create a campaign for the Munich event
cases.note: 'Create a campaign' means the Salesforce record, not designing a campaign.

cases.prompt: How is paid social doing?
cases.note: Paid social is a demand channel, so analysis. Contrast with amb-05.

cases.prompt: How are people talking about us on social?
cases.note: Social sentiment is brand, not the paid social channel.

cases.prompt: Which content should we be promoting more?
cases.note: About existing content performance, not writing new content.

cases.prompt: We need better content for the EMEA campaign
cases.note: The mirror of amb-06. This one is a request to create.

cases.prompt: Tell me about the accounts coming to the Munich event
cases.note: Qualitative background, so briefs rather than pipeline in the room.

cases.prompt: How much pipeline is attached to the Munich event accounts?
cases.note: The mirror of amb-08. Commercial total, not background.

cases.prompt: How are we doing this quarter?
cases.note: Deliberately vague. Analysis is the right default; either pipeline health or campaign performance is acceptable.

cases.prompt: Give me the deck
cases.note: Ambiguous between the two decks. Asking a clarifying question is a correct outcome; landing in analysis is what matters.

cases.prompt: Which accounts should we be going after in Germany?
cases.note: Geographic and unworked-account framing points at events over ABM. A defensible ABM answer would not be a hard failure.

cases.prompt: Run account intel and then gap and value mapping for ACC-001.
cases.note: ABM must return to its coordinator and execute both dependent steps.

cases.prompt: Find my top ABM accounts, then write an anchor asset for the highest-priority account.
cases.note: The root must continue to Content after ABM returns its selection.

cases.prompt: Build an ABM email sequence for ACC-001 and deploy its audience to Marketo.
cases.note: Creative ABM work precedes the Marketing Ops deployment task.

cases.prompt: Summarise the pipeline attached to accounts attending the Munich event.
cases.note: Event attendance and pipeline-in-room framing must not be absorbed by ABM.

turns: What are my top ABM accounts?
How did our campaigns perform last week?
cases.note: A new turn in the same session must restart at root rather than remain in ABM.
